parts.text: It's telling me that it can't reach Ollama.
Check that `OLLAMA_API_BASE` points to a running Ollama server (troubleshooting.md).

response.content:
---
title: Troubleshooting
---
# Troubleshooting

## The assistant cites the wrong page

Rebuild the search index with `docs-assistant index --rebuild`.

## The assistant cannot reach Ollama

Check that `OLLAMA_API_BASE` points to a running Ollama server.

parts.text: Check that `OLLAMA_API_BASE` points to a running Ollama server (troubleshooting.md).
How do I make the assistant use a local model instead of Gemini?
Set `OLLAMA_API_BASE` to use a local model instead of Gemini (install.md).

response.content:
---
title: CLI reference
---
# CLI reference

## ask

`docs-assistant ask QUESTION` prints an answer with citation links.

## index

`docs-assistant index --rebuild` drops the search index and builds it again from the docs folder.

---
title: Install
---
# Install

## Requirements

Python 3.12 or later.

## Use a local model

Set `OLLAMA_API_BASE` to use a local model instead of Gemini.
